decisions.executionNote: Begin left-tube approach, raising and pitching the left wrist while preserving elbow-up continuity; right arm stays home.
Advance above the left tube and align the gripper's longitudinal axis with the tube; keep fingers open.
Lower over the left tube with small increments and finish downward grasp alignment; inspect wrist centering before closing.
Fine-center the tube between the fingers, shift grip toward its upper body, then close fully.
Lift the closed left gripper clear of the tabletop and check whether the tube follows.
Carry the retained left tube toward the left rack slot while gradually rotating it upright.
Finish rotating the tube upright above the left rack opening, keeping a vertical insertion clearance.
Replan from the interrupted pose with smaller wrist increments; finish upright alignment over the left slot.
Lower the upright tube partway toward the left opening, using a small centering correction before the insertion stage.
Correct the tube's fore-aft alignment over the front-left large slot while maintaining clearance.
Insert the first tube vertically into the aligned left slot, keeping the grasp closed until seating is inspected.
Make a very small seating correction, release the first tube, and begin clearing the gripper to inspect its support in the rack.
Clear the released first tube and begin the right arm's approach to the diagonal tube in its own workspace.
Return the left arm toward home while advancing the right wrist above the diagonal tube and aligning for a downward grasp.
Use smaller increments after the continuity rejection, easing the left arm home and finishing right-tube alignment above the table.
Lower the centered right gripper to grasp height, keeping it open; complete the left arm's slow return.
Close the right gripper around the centered tube and allow the grasp to settle before lifting.
Lift the second tube clear of the table with the right gripper fully closed; verify retention before transport.
Transport the retained second tube toward the right rack slot while rotating it upright in small continuous increments.
Continue the controlled upright rotation and approach over the rack's right side; keep the left arm at home.
Finish upright orientation and center above the rightmost front-row slot, maintaining clearance before descent.
Lower the upright second tube toward the right slot, pausing above final insertion depth to inspect alignment.
Continue the second tube's vertical insertion into the right-side opening while keeping the grasp closed.
Release the second tube without further downward pressure, then clear the gripper to inspect its support and slot alignment.
Clear the seated second tube and move the open right gripper toward the remaining tube, beginning a gradual downward reorientation.
Move across the right workspace above the remaining tube and continue pitching the open gripper down with continuous elbow-up motion.
Finish downward alignment above the remaining tube, adapting its axis to the live head view before descending.
Lower the open gripper toward the third tube's upper body, with a small longitudinal centering correction.
Fine-center the third tube in the wrist view, then close the right gripper around its body.
Lift the third tube with the right gripper closed, checking that it follows before moving toward the rack.
Carry the retained third tube toward the central empty slot, gradually turning it upright while maintaining clearance above the inserted tubes.
Continue transporting the third tube high above the rack, with a gradual upright rotation and the left arm stationary.
Finish turning the third tube upright above the central rack opening, maintaining height to clear the two seated tubes.
Center the third tube over an empty central opening and begin a slow vertical approach, keeping it clear of its seated neighbors.
Continue lowering the third tube with a small visual centering correction toward the empty central slot.
Insert the third tube straight down toward the same seating height as its neighbors, keeping the grasp closed until release.
Release the third tube without further downward pressure; back away slightly to inspect whether it settles upright in the slot.
Withdraw the open right gripper from the three tubes and start returning both arms to their initial poses while allowing the tubes to settle.
The middle tube appears tilted after release. Reapproach it with the right gripper open to correct its seating rather than assume completion.
Adjust the open fingers toward the tilted middle tube's upper body and partially match its lean for a careful regrasp.
Close carefully around the tilted middle tube's exposed body, without moving the neighboring tubes.
Lift the regrasped middle tube along its lean to clear the slot rim before straightening it.
Straighten the retained middle tube above the rack and refine its alignment to the central large opening before reinsertion.
Use the wrist view to move the tube from above a small aperture toward the adjacent large opening, retaining clearance.
The tube tip is now above the large opening in the wrist view. Lower vertically in small increments for reinsertion.
The corrected tube appears upright at seating height. Release without further downward pressure and withdraw slightly to verify support.
The middle tube toppled rather than staying seated. Clear the open gripper to obtain an unobstructed view for recovery, leaving the other two tubes undisturbed.
Begin reorienting the right gripper above the fallen tube for a new grasp, keeping clearance from the two upright tubes.
Continue the high-clearance reorientation toward the fallen tube, keeping the right link on its own side of the workspace.
Continue aligning the open right gripper with the fallen tube's length, approaching from above without disturbing its seated neighbors.
Finish the downward grasp orientation above the fallen tube's cap-side body, retaining an open gripper and clearance from the rack.
